one_liner: Threads API is a free Meta Graph-style REST API with OAuth 2.0 user tokens; only app roles/testers work without Meta App Review, so serving arbitrary users needs per-permission App Review. MCP status is unverified from the pages.
auth_notes: Authorization-code flow via the Authorization Window; short-lived tokens (1 hour) are exchanged for 60-day long-lived tokens, refreshable via GET /refresh_access_token.
access_notes: Developer credentials are self-serve through a Meta app with the Threads use case, and Threads testers/app role holders can grant permissions without review. App users without a role require each permission to pass App Review and the app to be published. Blotato's pricing page says Meta publishes no paid tier, but its body text was not fetched.
blocker_notes: Each Threads permission (threads_basic, threads_content_publish, threads_manage_replies, threads_read_replies, threads_manage_insights) must be approved via App Review, and the app published, before users without an app role can grant it. Without advanced access to threads_basic, only posts created by Threads testers are retrievable.
